Gateway protection, CSP/runtime settings and browser PKCE sign-in are prepared for paired review. Auth remains disabled. Native fixture creation, real Google federation, measured p99, live E2E and the remaining role-specific shell work are outstanding.

S1-02.notes: Owner accepted ADR-0008–0011 on 2026-10-11; decisions are merged in all three repositories. Live binding and latency proof are separate S1-18 acceptance work.

S1-03.notes: Backend and infra are merged and released in dev execution 7c97ec40-371c-4387-8c26-817c75450d4c. The arm64 live alias is READY with reserved concurrency 1 and provisioned concurrency 1/1. A synthetic uninvited Google event returned SIGN_UP_NOT_ALLOWED; the decision log had only safe fields and no email. Policy and PostgreSQL tests pass. The single 66 ms sample is not p99 proof; actual federated acceptance and measured cold/warm p99 remain. The pipeline build-list bootstrap issue was repaired before release. Two provisioned cold initialization samples were 2805.16 and 3057.93 ms; these small samples do not establish p99.

S1-15.notes: Trusted authorizer claims are carried through the Lambda adapter and released to dev. Protected-route integration remains S1-06/S1-14.

S1-17.notes: presignup_ro bootstrap and exact SELECT grants on users/invitations are merged and deployed. Negative privilege tests cover writes and unrelated future tables; the deployed trigger uses its scoped IAM connection.

Transactional actor resolution/binding, current database roles/status and the lazy two-connection IAM pool pass race/PostgreSQL/privacy checks. S1-07.notes: Backend #24 is merged and released. Central active-actor, same-org self/admin/supervisor/peer policies deny by default, require accepted relationships and reject storage errors. Admin grants no supervision override. /me demonstrates the handler policy call; later slices implement relationship storage.

S1-08.notes: Backend #24 is merged and released. The explicit /me DTO, no-store JSON and stable 401/403 problems pass schema/privacy tests; deployed unauthenticated /me returns 401 problem+json. Actual authenticated Gateway acceptance remains pending with activation.

S1-14.notes: Prepared Gateway JWT authorizer with issuer and SPA/dev-only test audiences; exactly one public health route is asserted for enabled environments. No-token release checks and scoped native invited/uninvited /me plus authenticated unknown-path checks are prepared. Default auth remains disabled; live activation acceptance is pending.

S1-16.notes: Prepared exact Cognito origin in CloudFront and local CSP, strict header assertions, and no unsafe directives. Public runtime auth settings are validated, uploaded without caching and invalidated with index.html. Paired infra/frontend release and live activation remain pending.

S1-10.notes: Prepared code/PKCE browser flow with state/nonce validation, callback URL cleanup, memory-only tokens, single-flight refresh and revocation plus hosted logout. 401/403 handling clears private cache and routes safely. Unit and intercepted browser tests cover replay, reload, refresh races, logout and denied profiles. Real Google sign-in/sign-out remain pending after activation.

S1-11.notes: Prepared themed signed-out landing, account-name menu, current profile and access-denied views. Serious accessibility checks and browser flows pass. Navigation for future role-specific feature pages and actual dev sign-in acceptance remain pending.

S1-12.notes: PostgreSQL regression tests reuse unchanged trusted claims after database admin/supervisor removal and deactivation, and reject token-group elevation for ordinary users. Role-authority runbook documents next-request enforcement, in-flight request timing and S5-05 Cognito follow-up. Review/merge remains pending; actual Gateway token acceptance is separately gated on activation.
